approved_deltas.delta: Replace prototype system chrome and footer compensation with measured safe areas, fixed header/footer and one flex middle scroll region while preserving reference coordinates.

Create Account validates the prior age and consent draft plus a valid email, an 8-128 character password containing a number and matching confirmation; then shows the custom 400-600ms Loading, derives a salted PBKDF2 credential, atomically creates the local account and enters fixed-code verification. No plaintext password, session or student certification is written.

Remove Apple registration functionality, button, icon and or-divider. The first source field follows the unchanged heading with its 14px margin; all other form controls retain source styling. This supersedes the earlier Apple-unavailable delta.

The source statement that email confirms student status must be replaced by the shortest truthful local-account disclosure while keeping the source note geometry; production student verification must not be claimed.

approved_deltas.source: Existing local credential contract in docs/cimoa-registration-onboarding.md
approved_deltas.delta: Password and confirmation use real masked fields, Show/Hide is functional, and the hint must not say Strong enough until the configured number rule also passes. Passwords remain memory-only and clear on hide/unmount.

When an unverified local account already exists, the page may show Continue verification and preserve its email instead of creating a duplicate account. This state is separate from the default pixel reference.
Back restores Community; direct entry falls back to Community. Log in pushes Login and Login Back restores Signup.

When the real keyboard reduces visualViewport height, keep the focused input in the only scroll region and temporarily fold the fixed source footer; restore it when the keyboard closes. Default output is unchanged.
